The wheel has six equally spaced shallow scallops, at least 33 mm minimum grip diameter, nominal 1.0 mm exposed-edge rounds and subtle raised grip dots that do not form glove catches.
Orientation and support decisions protect the upward-facing blind socket where feasible, retain an actual support/slicing preview, and identify any required support.
The concentric blind D socket is 10.0 mm deep and derives from a 6.00 mm round boundary and 5.20 mm across-flat shaft with 0.20 mm radial and 0.20 mm flat clearance.
At least 3.0 mm material remains above the blind socket and no set screw, insert, taper or keyway is added.
Non-mating prototype dimensions use the proposed ±0.25 mm tolerance while D-socket design values remain separate from future measured fit values.
